mining.hard_positive: Annotated object not matched at .50 or .75; not proof of annotation correctness
mining.image_class_difficulty: Mean object difficulty within class, zero for absent class; no FP contribution
mining.inference: Existing full-image adapter default shape; training dimensions only; unfused EMA, same precision/mapping/restoration
mining.object_difficulty: 1 for unmatched at .50; otherwise .5 for unmatched at .75; otherwise 0
mining.one_to_one_categories: Reuse wrist_eval.analyze.error_types unchanged; TP, classification, low_confidence, localization, no_residual_candidate
mining.potential_hard_negative: Unmatched prediction >=.25; separately count >=.50; never a verified negative

qualitative.controls: Two SHA-ordered all-correct clinical annotation cases
qualitative.hard_positive: One per clinical class, SHA ordered; no image reuse
qualitative.potential_fp: Up to two distinct-patient images per class, SHA ordered, >=.25 unmatched; no outcome-selected replacements
qualitative.review: Technical only; no clinical negative adjudication or relabeling

stability.rule: Outcome-independent SHA-256 ordering, seed42; uniform pool union first32 each clinical class; epochs10 and40 chosen by time, not scores; no extra training
